items.title: RevMed’s pancreatic cancer drug breezes through with swift approval
items.summary: Revolution Medicines’ breakthrough drug for pancreatic cancer was approved more than six months ahead of schedule.

items.title: Metsera backers establish new biotech armed with China-licensed immunology asset
items.summary: PHP and ARCH have established Sentivera, a biotech that now has an immunology licensing deal with China-based Haisco.

items.title: Jazz secures FDA approval for Ziihera in advanced HER2+ GEA
items.summary: The FDA has approved two Jazz Pharmaceuticals regimens containing Ziihera for the first-line treatment of adults with unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic HER2-positive GEA.

items.title: ESC 2026: Common pharma excipient linked to uptick in cardiovascular risk
items.summary: Researchers call for further exploration of xylitol’s impact on heart health as its use in food and pharma continues to rise.

items.title: McKesson to acquire Precision Medicine Group for $2.25bn
items.summary: US-based healthcare services provider McKesson has agreed to acquire Precision Medicine Group for $2.25bn.
